Shivraj Singh Chouhan Protests Bulldozer Action by CM Mohan Yadav

Former Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan staged a protest in Budhni against Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's administration's bulldozer action targeting tribal individuals. Chouhan expressed anger over the demolition of encroachments in the area, stating that the people affected had helped elect Yadav as Chief Minister. The protest reportedly caused a rift within the BJP.
